incompleteInstallation.title: One Person Lab installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so the local service cannot start. Restart and recheck first. If resources are still missing, review the components below and the app logs, then check the quarantine history in security or antivirus software. Reinstall from the official release page after confirming files were removed.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest One Person Lab package. If it still happens, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined One Person Lab components.

startupDirectory.title: A local service folder is unavailable
startupDirectory.permissionDeniedDescription: The local service cannot access its configured work or log folder because the current user does not have permission.
startupDirectory.permissionDeniedAction: Grant the current user read and write access to the configured work and log folders, then restart One Person Lab App.
startupDirectory.unavailableDescription: The local service cannot start because its configured work or log folder is missing or unavailable.
startupDirectory.unavailableAction: Restore or create the configured folder, make sure it is writable, then restart One Person Lab App.

genericFailure.title: The local service could not start
genericFailure.description: One Person Lab App stopped startup because its local service failed to start.
genericFailure.action: Restart One Person Lab App. If the failure continues, review the application logs before changing configuration or reinstalling the app.

pendingSlow.title: Starting local service
pendingSlow.description: The One Person Lab local service is still starting. Please wait; the app will continue automatically when it is ready.

exited.title: Local service startup ended
exited.description: The local service exited before startup completed.
exited.action: Restart One Person Lab App. If this keeps happening, review or copy the diagnostics below and report the issue.

transientConcurrentStartup.title: One Person Lab is already starting
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another One Person Lab process is finishing startup with the same local data. This is temporary; your data is safe and reinstalling will not help.
transientConcurrentStartup.action: Wait a moment, then restart One Person Lab. If this keeps happening, report the issue on GitHub.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: One Person Lab App detected that its local database is corrupted, so the local service cannot continue startup. After confirmation, One Person Lab App will back up the old database, create a new local database, and restart the local service. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
